title: Hampton Street School had no American Indian or Alaska Native students in 2025-26
text:
Hampton Street School counted zero American Indian or Alaska Native students in its 2025-26 enrollment, a NaN% change from the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department .
In total, Hampton Street School enrolled 330 students for 2025-26. Of those, American Indian or Alaska Native students made up 0%, making it the school’s least represented ethnic group.
The school operates within Mineola Union Free School District, whose main offices are based in Mineola.
Jackson Avenue School reported the district’s highest number of American Indian or Alaska Native students at the same time, enrolling one student.
An analysis from World Population Review found that New York’s public education system ranked second in the U.S. , but stood at 31st place for K-12 performance.
